description: This file declares functions related to managing radio traffic harvesting settings, including configuration of reporting and polling periods, harvesting status, and override time-to-live (TTL) values.

methods.name: SetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the current harvesting status for radio traffic scans; returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status as a boolean value.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Configures the reporting interval for radio traffic scans in seconds; returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Returns the current reporting period in seconds.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling interval for radio traffic scans in seconds; returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Returns the current polling period in seconds.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period in seconds.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period in seconds.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout interval in seconds after which RIS intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout for RIS scans with accelerated polling in seconds; returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Returns the default timeout value for RIS override in seconds.

methods.name: ValidateRISPeriod
methods.description: Validates whether the given interval is within the acceptable range; returns TRUE if valid, FALSE otherwise.
